stem.en: A charge of 2 C sits at a point where the potential is 5 V. What is its potential energy there?
stem.et: Laeng 2 C asub punktis, kus potentsiaal on 5 V. Milline on selle potentsiaalne energia seal?

label.en: 10 J — potential energy is charge times potential
label.et: 10 J — potentsiaalne energia on laeng korda potentsiaal

label.en: 5 J, since potential energy equals the potential regardless of charge
label.et: 5 J, sest potentsiaalne energia võrdub potentsiaaliga, sõltumata laengust

label.en: 2.5 J, from dividing potential by charge
Undefined, since potential and potential energy cannot be combined
label.et: Määramata, sest potentsiaali ja potentsiaalset energiat ei saa kombineerida
